notes.title: Backyard Baseball '01 Update Alert
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246326/3da7ca12c363cbd06b3b3f4753eabea156caf24b.png"]Hi-ho Baseball Fans!
 
Patch 1.0.8 has arrived and is jam packed with improvements we've made since launch. 
Here's the breakdown of all the improvements to the game:

Stability and Performance Improvements
Fixed the Out of Array pointers crash

Fixed instances of stats corruption after playing multiple games

Fixed the crash that occurs when relaunching a save in the middle of an extra inning

Fixed the issue where options are not being retained in the sound settings when relaunching the game
Fixed Visual Bugs
Fixed a UI visual glitch in batting practice that occurs on the third strike.

Fixed a visual bug in the Hall of Fame screen that's displaying the incorrect team color.

Fixed the visual bug in the statistics page that was showing unreliable data.

Realigned the #5 to other characters used when creating a new coach.

Fixed the visual bug where the field that’s being selected in batting practice isn’t consistent with the one being presented in-game.
Audio Improvements
Adjusted the background sound to restart in the appropriate screens

NOTE: We also want to inform players that updating to this version will revert progress back to their last completed game. 

If you run into any further bugs after this patch, please keep sending them our way through the following options:

Bug Report Form

Support Email: Support@megacatstudios.com

Join us on Discord

notes.title: Backyard Baseball '01 Patch Update Alert
notes.content:
Update 1.0.0 - 1.0.3
Hi-ho Baseball Fans!

Your Day 1 Patch notes compilation has finally arrived, and we're here to give you a breakdown of all the little improvements we made to the game today.

Patches 1.0.0-1.0.3 include the following fixes:

Fixed an issue where the Expand Screen function was force-disabled on launch

Addressed a legacy DirectX check issue that causes periodic device-specific crashes

Update to the intro cinematic

Fixed memory management issues causing heap exhaustion

Restoring this game to its former glory can be a bumpy process, but we're committed to making your experience the best it can be and really appreciate your help and feedback along the way.

If you run into any further bugs after this patch, please keep sending them our way through the following options:

Bug Report Form

Support Email: support@megacatstudios.com

Join us on Discord
